import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD_CONST = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] rock1 = new int[3];
        int[] sci1 = new int[3];
        int[] paper1 = new int[3];
        int[] rock2 = new int[3];
        int[] sci2 = new int[3];
        int[] paper2 = new int[3];

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            rock1[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            sci1[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            paper1[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            rock2[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            sci2[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            paper2[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        int maxScore = computeMax(rock1, sci1, paper1, rock2, sci2, paper2);
        int minScore = findMin(rock1, sci1, paper1, rock2, sci2, paper2);
        System.out.println(minScore + " " + maxScore);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int computeMax(int[] r1, int[] s1, int[] p1, int[] r2, int[] s2, int[] p2) {
        return Math.min(r1[0], s2[1]) + Math.min(s1[1], p2[2]) + Math.min(p1[2], r2[0]);
    }

    static int evaluate(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) {
            return 0;
        } else if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1)) {
            return 1;
        } else {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    static int process(List<int[]> l1, List<int[]> l2) {
        int totalScore = 0;
        int c1Count = 0, c2Count = 0;
        int c1Type = 0, c2Type = 0;

        while (!l1.isEmpty() || !l2.isEmpty()) {
            if (c1Count == 0 && !l1.isEmpty()) {
                int[] c1 = l1.remove(l1.size() - 1);
                c1Count = c1[0];
                c1Type = c1[1];
            }
            if (c2Count == 0 && !l2.isEmpty()) {
                int[] c2 = l2.remove(l2.size() - 1);
                c2Count = c2[0];
                c2Type = c2[1];
            }
            if (c1Count == 0 || c2Count == 0) {
                break;
            }
            int minCount = Math.min(c1Count, c2Count);
            int score = Math.max(0, minCount * evaluate(c1Type, c2Type));
            totalScore += score;
            c1Count -= minCount;
            c2Count -= minCount;
        }
        return totalScore;
    }

    static int findMin(int[] r1, int[] s1, int[] p1, int[] r2, int[] s2, int[] p2) {
        List<int[]> perms1 = generatePermutations(new int[][] {
            {r1[0], 1},
            {s1[1], 2},
            {p1[2], 3}
        });
        List<int[]> perms2 = generatePermutations(new int[][] {
            {r2[0], 1},
            {s2[1], 2},
            {p2[2], 3}
        });
        int answer = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (List<int[]> p1Perm : perms1) {
            for (List<int[]> p2Perm : perms2) {
                List<int[]> p1Copy = deepCopy(p1Perm);
                List<int[]> p2Copy = deepCopy(p2Perm);
                int current = process(p1Copy, p2Copy);
                if (current < answer) {
                    answer = current;
                }
            }
        }
        return answer;
    }

    static List<int[]> generatePermutations(int[][] array) {
        List<int[]> result = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(array, 0, result);
        return result;
    }

    static void permute(int[][] array, int start, List<int[]> result) {
        if (start == array.length - 1) {
            result.add(Arrays.copyOf(array[start], array[start].length));
        } else {
            for (int i = start; i < array.length; i++) {
                swap(array, start, i);
                permute(array, start + 1, result);
                swap(array, start, i);
            }
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[][] array, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }

    static List<int[]> deepCopy(List<int[]> list) {
        return list.stream().map(arr -> Arrays.copyOf(arr, arr.length)).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}
